psrc.sharepoint

Read and write files in PSRC SharePoint site drives with a small set of functions built on Microsoft365R.

read_msxl(site, drive, filepath, sheet = NULL, ...)
read_txt(site, drive, filepath, ...)
write_msxl(x, site, drive, filepath, sheet = "Sheet1", overwrite = TRUE)
write_txt(x, site, drive, filepath, overwrite = TRUE, ...)

Text-file delimiters follow the file extension: .csv and .txt use commas, and .tab uses tabs. The package connects to the PSRC tenant and the specified drive in each site. Temporary local copies are removed when each function finishes. Excel reads support .xls and .xlsx workbooks. Writes replace an existing destination by default; set overwrite = FALSE to refuse an upload when that destination already exists.
